prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Find your ideal pet companion", "Answer 3 quick questions or skip straight to path selection.", "What kind of desk buddy do you need?", "We will match you with a pet personality that fits your workday flow.", "Quiet companion / Playful break buddy / Task focus helper"]
1: ["Save & Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Sign in to keep your pet save data safely linked to your account across devices.", "Your adopted companion stays saved to this login.", "Continue to Secure Sync"]
2: ["Quick Desktop Pet Controls", "Click and drag to move your pet, right-click to hide to tray, or tap spacebar to chat.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Customize Your Desktop Friend", "Select colors, traits, and behavior style to see your pet come to life."]
4: ["Sign In to Retain Your Pet & Progress", "Signing in ensures your pet stays on your desktop whenever you relaunch."]
5: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"]
6: ["Claim Free Starter Treat Pack"]
7: ["Quick Setup: Most users complete onboarding in under 2 minutes!"]
8: ["Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to bring up the quick action menu!"]
9: ["Upload a Clear Photo for Custom Pet Creation", "Use well-lit, frontal photos with clear backgrounds for best results."]
